messages:
Maya (partnerships): kickoff: FortuKey (HSM) + AtlasSI (SI) want a joint marketplace tile + integration guide. target: staging listing in 12 days. main asks: SAML metadata exchange, SCIM delta sync, KMS wrap/unwrap compatibility, and a short compliance checklist.
Ana (FortuKey): we support PKCS#11 + a wrap/unwrap REST endpoint at /api/v1/keys/wrap. have FIPS 140-2 and attestation report. can provide test certs and sample CSR.
Julian (AtlasSI): we'll run pilot with two customers. need SCIM mapping and SSO metadata. also want a minimal onboarding script for SEs.
Ibrahim (security): checklist highlights: attestation chain validation, wrap/unwrap test vectors, enforce HSM-backed keys via policy, SAML fingerprint exchange, and SCIM incremental sync. I'll put a short checklist doc.
Keiko (product): marketplace asks: short description, 3 bullets, screenshots, and an architecture diagram. can we get a small data flow diagram from FortuKey?
Ana (FortuKey): uploading diagram: https://cdn.fortukey.example.com/redwood/flow-v2.png
Julian (AtlasSI): SCIM sample mapping suggestion: userName <- emails[0].value, displayName <- name.formatted, groups <- roles. prefer using since query param for delta sync. example snippet:
```json
{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:User"],"userName":"r.patel@org.com","name":{"formatted":"Rashmi Patel"},"emails":[{"value":"r.patel@org.com"}],"groups":["devops"]}
```
Maya (partnerships): will add that to the partner playbook. action items: @Ibrahim produce security checklist by Tue EOD; @Nora draft co-marketing addendum + embargo window; @Julian scaffold onboarding script; @Ana send certs + test creds; @Keiko create marketplace placeholder.
Nora (legal): embargo: no public announcement before 2024-08-01 16:00 PT. need logo release forms and a co-marketing addendum. I'll circulate templates.
ci-bot: Repo created: partners/fortukey-atlassi-integration - initial CI: scim,saml,wrap-tests.
Ibrahim (security): I'll add wrap/unwrap test vectors and a fallback policy: if attestation fails, route to Redwood-wrapped KMS key.
Ana (FortuKey): sending test certs and service account to the vault link. joining pilot next Wed.
Keiko (product): confirm we can gate the listing to early access accounts for the pilot? want to limit exposure.
Maya (partnerships): yes, Keiko: product can set a gating toggle. next sync Fri 11am PT. I'll post calendar invite. :calendar:
